text:
Jordan Grimmer-Tufik Thank you so much 🤗 

To be honest, I wasn’t aware of the requirement to submit docs 3 months in advance. I am registered with the Afula branch, and in previous years I usually contacted them more than 2 months before my visa expired.

In fact, they often told me not to book too early and to contact them only about one month before the expiration date. Because of that, I assumed I was following the correct procedure.

I will try contacting them again and ask whether an earlier appointment is possible. Thank you for the information. 🙏
